validation_results.thompson_sampling_references: Documentation and metadata only - no implementation

line_count_changes.note: Reduction represents removal of ML calculation logic and replacement with thin HTTP clients. The impulse-learning.ts file increased slightly due to improved documentation and data collection structure.

architectural_boundaries_enforced.details: Beta distribution sampling logic removed from metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/session/template-selector.ts. Now delegates to RPC API endpoint. Only documentation references remain in opencode.
Pattern extraction and quality calculation logic removed from opencode. Only raw data collection remains. All learning algorithms now in rpc-api/server/routes/learning_loop.py.
Success rate, quality score, and averaging calculations removed from template-metrics-client.ts. File is now a thin HTTP client (<100 effective lines). All calculations in rpc-api.

data_flows_established.path: opencode → POST /api/v2/activities/templates/{id}/select → rpc-api performs Beta sampling → returns selected template → opencode loads and executes
opencode completes activity turn → collects raw execution data → POST /api/v1/learning-loop/record-turn → rpc-api extracts patterns and calculates quality scores → stores in SurrealDB
opencode reports execution result → POST /api/v1/learning-loop/executions → rpc-api calculates success rates and updates Redis → stores in SurrealDB

storage_consolidation.note: All metrics and learning data now flows through rpc-api to SurrealDB (primary) and Redis (cache). No local JSON file writes from opencode.

next_steps.phase_2: Consolidate storage layer - complete SurrealDB migration from Redis
next_steps.phase_3: Complete learning loop - implement context requirements evolution in rpc-api
next_steps.phase_4: Metabob-cli gateway implementation - add enrichment layer with inference models

metabob_opencode.role: Activity execution, coordination, data collection ONLY

metabob_rpc_api.role: ML learning, metrics training, Thompson Sampling, all data maintenance

metabob_cli.role: Data collection, enrichment with inference models, gateway to activity database
